author: BMWK
title: Stromspeicher-Strategie: Handlungsfelder und Maßnahmen für eine anhaltende Ausbaudynamik und optimale Systemintegration von Stromspeichern
evidence: 18 action fields incl. grid fees, Baukostenzuschuesse, faster grid connections, control reserve improvements; successor to the Section 118(6) EnWG exemption to be discussed

author: BDEW
title: BDEW-Stellungnahme zur Stromspeicher-Strategie des BMWK
evidence: Calls for successor to grid-fee exemption and further development of Baukostenzuschuesse; asks for prioritisation of strategy measures

author: Gleiss Lutz
title: Stromspeicher-Strategie des BMWK – regulatorischer Aufwind für Stromspeicher
evidence: Double burden of storage as generator and consumer; storage economics depend largely on control-reserve prices; strategy 'vor allem bislang ein Statusbericht'

author: Figgener et al.
title: The development of battery storage systems in Germany: A market review (status 2023)
evidence: FCR market 570 MW vs 630 MW prequalified large-scale storage; price drop attributed to saturation by battery storage; shift towards aFRR

author: Bundesnetzagentur
title: Bundesnetzagentur veröffentlicht Diskussionspapier zur Bildung der Stromnetzentgelte (AgNes)
evidence: Storage fees addressed separately; open-ended decision process ('ergebnisoffen'); possible feed-in charges

author: pv magazine (S. Enkhardt)
title: 50 Hertz: Keine neuen Netzanschlusszusagen für Projekte vor 2029 mehr möglich
evidence: Connection capacity for 2025-2029 exhausted; 103 of 110 GW pending applications are large batteries; first-come first-served

author: Solarserver
title: Netzanschlüsse von großen Batteriespeichern: Neue Zahlen der Bundesnetzagentur
evidence: 9710 connection requests for about 400 GW in 2024 versus about 2.3 GW operating

author: FfE and Stiftung Umweltenergierecht
title: Neue Netzentgelt-Privilegien für Speicheranlagen und Ladepunkte – Stehen die Befreiungen auf dünnem Eis?
evidence: 'Die Vollbefreiung für Speicheranlagen steht auf dünnem Eis'; regulator can set different rules at any time

author: VCI
title: Stellungnahme: Orientierungspunkte der BNetzA zu Speichernetzentgelten im Rahmen von AgNes
evidence: Opposes shortening Section 118(6) exemption; planning uncertainty causing postponed or cancelled investments; warns of stranded assets

author: Bundesnetzagentur
title: BNetzA präsentiert erstmals ein Gesamtkonzept für zukünftige Netzentgelte Strom ab 2029
evidence: Storage to pay a moderate capacity price but no volumetric grid fee; charges start after Section 118(6) special rules expire; framework decision planned end-2026

author: pv magazine (M. Großkrüger)
title: Wer bei Batteriespeichern nur auf 2029 schaut, übersieht den entscheidenden zweiten Stichtag
evidence: Draft AgNes adds an FID cut-off; 'Ob deren Erlöse tragen, ist offen'; viability should not hinge on one regulatory exemption; cites an EWI (2026) study expecting saturation and falling revenues in reserve markets

author: Energimarknadsinspektionen
title: Främjande av ett mer flexibelt elsystem, deluppdrag 5 (Ei R2023:18)
evidence: Large batteries expected to be a significant share of flexibility; support schemes for storage listed as an option; aggregators as enablers

author: Svenska kraftnät
title: Introduction of marginal pricing on FCR markets
evidence: From 1 February 2024 all FCR products settled pay-as-cleared instead of pay-as-bid

author: CheckWatt
title: Batterirapporten 2024
evidence: Frequency-service income about SEK 4500 per kW and year in 2022-2023; compensation expected to fall as installations grow; aggregation via virtual power plant

author: Government Offices of Sweden
title: Uppdrag att förbättra flexibiliteten i elsystemet (KN2024/01432)
evidence: Mandate to the Energy Agency on flexibility; no national storage strategy set out

author: Svenska kraftnät
title: Månadsrapport FCR – september 2024
evidence: Low prices for all FCR products; growing entry of wind and battery owners; effect of pay-as-cleared pricing; FCR-D dimensioning 1450 MW

author: Svenska kraftnät
title: Månadsrapport FCR – februari 2025
evidence: FCR-D up and down averaged under 3 EUR/MW; FCR-N just under 15 EUR/MW; 'prispressen fortsatt är mycket stark'

author: Svenska kraftnät
title: Kortsiktig marknadsanalys 2024: Analys av kraftsystemet 2025–2029
evidence: Battery volume available for flexibility in Sweden rising from about 924 MW (2025) to 1327 MW (2029)

author: Montel (J. Strøm)
title: Battery storage market insights: Sweden
evidence: Prequalified FCR-D capacity rose from under 10 MW to about 600 MW (2023-2024) against demand below 550 MW; market saturated in 2024; about EUR 100000/MW/yr

author: Energiföretagen Sverige
title: Hemställan om undanröjande av dubbelbeskattning för batterilagring belägna vid elproduktionsanläggningar
evidence: Energy tax refund for stored electricity not applied when routed via non-concession grids; requests law change from 2027
